versions.subject: Merge PR #4735 from @nasbench - Slash&Grab Exploitation Related Rule Updates
versions.detection:
selection_main:
    - CommandLine|contains|all:
          # net.exe
          - 'localgroup '
          - ' /add'
    - CommandLine|contains|all:
          # powershell.exe
          - 'Add-LocalGroupMember '
          - ' -Group '
selection_group:
    CommandLine|contains:
        - 'Group Policy Creator Owners'
        - 'Schema Admins'
condition: all of selection_*
versions.spl: (CommandLine="*localgroup *" CommandLine="* /add*") OR (CommandLine="*Add-LocalGroupMember *" CommandLine="* -Group *") CommandLine IN ("*Group Policy Creator Owners*", "*Schema Admins*")
